def: Microsoft's open-source framework for building agents and graph-based workflows, released as 1.0 for .NET and Python on 3 April 2026 as the successor to AutoGen and Semantic Kernel.
practice: Ships sequential, concurrent, handoff, group-chat and Magentic orchestrations with checkpointing and human approval; several integrations, such as hosted agents and AG-UI, were still in preview at 1.0.
